meta.name: caveman
meta.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode that cuts output tokens while keeping technical accuracy. Levels: lite, full, ultra and the wenyan variants. Use for /caveman, "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "be brief" or "less tokens".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把冗长回复压成极简短句,省字又不丢技术要点。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果嫌 AI 回话啰嗦,想用更少字数抓到关键信息。
copy.tagline_en: Compress long replies into terse lines that keep the technical points.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if replies feel too wordy and you want the key points in fewer words.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 默认整个会话都用压缩的「穴居人」风格回答:去掉冠词、客套和铺垫,只留技术事实、代码块和原文报错。级别可选 lite、full、ultra 及文言变体,默认 full。
howto.when: 当你说 /caveman、「caveman mode」、「be brief」等触发词时进入该模式;之后每轮回答都保持,直到你说「stop caveman」或「normal mode」才恢复正常。

say.note: 切到 ultra 级别,压缩更狠
进入默认的 full 压缩风格

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude answers every response in a compressed caveman style by default: drops articles, filler and pleasantries, keeps technical facts, code blocks and exact errors. Levels: lite, full, ultra, wenyan variants; default is full.
howto.when_en: Triggers on /caveman, "caveman mode", "be brief" and similar phrases. Stays on each response until you say "stop caveman" or "normal mode".
